decisions.reason: Accumulated sunk costs and the public launch of the express program, though only moderately visible, favor continued persistence.
Strong public commitment via homepage display and European certification costs make withdrawal highly unlikely from an escalation-of-commitment view.
The multi-model express line's dedicated web presence and substantial sunk investment create strong commitment to persist.
The digital services platform is central to the announced service-oriented direction with high visibility and sunk costs, so dropping is unlikely.
